programme.title: Golmaal
programme.desc: Ramprasad works for Bhavani, who discourages his employees from pursuing any hobbies. Things take a hilarious turn when Bhavani catches Ramprasad at a hockey match and he lies about having a twin.

programme.title: Shalimar
programme.desc: Kumar, a thief, aspires to be mafia boss Sir John's successor by stealing Shalimar, a priceless diamond. Adamant to succeed in his mission, Kumar must overcome many tribulations to seize the diamond.

programme.title: Chupke Chupke
programme.desc: Mischievous botany professor Parimal Tripathi (Dharmendra) plays a little trick on his brother-in-law Raghav (Om Prakash). Jealous of the high esteem in which his own wife, Sulekha (Amitabh Bachchan), holds the other man, Parimal decides to impersonate Raghav's new driver. Laying the groundwork for a series of hilarious misunderstandings, the disguised professor throws doubt on his wife's fidelity and gets his best buddy, Sukumar (Sharmila Tagore), to help out by impersonating Parimal.

programme.title: Karm
programme.desc: Young lovers Arvind and Asha plan to marry, but when Asha's astrologer father predicts that her fiancée will die on their wedding day, the couple decide to sidestep fate and simply live together.

programme.title: Gumrah
programme.desc: Meena, who lives with her retired and widowed father in rural Nainital, is visited by her sister, her husband and her two children. Meena speaks of her love for Rajendra, a painter and singer, and Kamla, her sister, approves of her choice. However, before Meena can make a move, Kamla passes away leaving her children in the hands of Meena.
